dcterms:description: The VIPeR dataset is a widely used dataset for person re-identification, containing 632 pedestrian pairs, each with two images of the same person captured from different camera views. The images show significant viewpoint changes, often exceeding 90 degrees, and are normalized to a resolution of 128 × 48 for evaluations.
dcterms:title: VIPeR Dataset

dcterms:description: The CUHK01 dataset consists of 971 persons, each represented by two images captured from two different camera views. The dataset is designed for person re-identification and includes images normalized to a resolution of 160 × 60 for evaluations.
dcterms:title: CUHK01 Dataset
